events.title: Tariq ibn Ziyad defeats King Roderic at Guadalete
events.description: Umayyad forces under Tariq ibn Ziyad defeated and killed the Visigothic king Roderic, by the traditional date. Within a few years most of Iberia was under Muslim rule, the beginning of al-Andalus.

events.title: Mary Tudor is proclaimed Queen of England in London
events.description: As support for Lady Jane Grey collapsed, the Privy Council proclaimed Mary queen to cheering crowds. England's first undisputed queen regnant restored Catholicism and burned some 280 Protestants.

events.title: The Seneca Falls Convention opens
events.description: Elizabeth Cady Stanton and Lucretia Mott opened the first women's rights convention in the United States. Its Declaration of Sentiments, stating that 'all men and women are created equal', launched the suffrage movement.
events.html: Elizabeth Cady Stanton and Lucretia Mott opened the first women's rights convention in the United States. Its Declaration of Sentiments, stating that 'all men and women are created equal', launched the suffrage movement.

events.title: France declares war on Prussia
events.description: Provoked by Bismarck's edited Ems Dispatch, Napoleon III's government declared war on Prussia. Within months France was defeated, the Second Empire fell and the German Empire was proclaimed at Versailles.
events.html: Provoked by Bismarck's edited Ems Dispatch, Napoleon III's government declared war on Prussia. Within months France was defeated, the Second Empire fell and the German Empire was proclaimed at Versailles.

events.title: Sandinista rebels take power in Nicaragua
events.description: Two days after Anastasio Somoza Debayle fled, Sandinista forces entered Managua, ending the Somoza family's 43-year rule. The revolution soon drew the US into backing the Contra insurgency.
